newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea H1 overseas construction orders up 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea H1 overseas construction orders up 34 pct.

text.p: Overseas construction orders won by South Korean contractors rose 34 percent to $7.1 billion in the first half of this year from $5.3 billion a year earlier, the construction ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry said the number of contracts rose to 89 in the period from 81 a year before.
Orders from Asian countries totalled $5.3 billion comprising 66 contracts, up from $3.9 billion (59 contracts) a year ago, it said.
Orders from the Middle East increased to $459 million from $401 million.
Among countries, China led the way with 13 orders totalling $1.4 billion, followed by Indonesia with 11 orders worth $924 million, the ministry said.
Hyundai Engineering and Construction Co won 16 orders worth $2.2 billion in the six-month period and Daewoo Corp 10 orders worth $2.0 billion, it said.
